services.name: Charter Fishing
services.desc: Duluth Charter Fishing Captain Peter Dahl is a lifelong resident of Duluth, where he grew up on the banks of the St Louis river. He has fished since he was big enough to hold a pole. As a young man he trolled the waters of Lake Superior with his brother, dad and uncle. Even before the comeback of lake trout, and the planting of salmon. He fished for steelhead on the North Shore and Isle Royale, lake trout on the south shore. He has been chartering Lake Superior for 35 years. A fourth generation licensed captain, Captain Dave Dahl upholds a long line of fishing tradition in his family.
